content:
Public events are a subset of quests in *Fallout 76*; with *The Backwoods* update in 2026, smaller events were renamed to activities, while public events maintained their pre-existing terminology. Activities are shared quests that spawn around the world and are only available to be completed for a limited amount of time before they despawn and go back on cooldown. Every 20 minutes (x:20, x:40, x:00), a random public event will be available. These quests are displayed under the section "DAILY" of the Pip-Boy.

Any player character can participate in these public events, regardless of level, and most public events encourage player characters to team up to complete the objective.

Public events appear in rotation with an alert on the HUD. They have automatic respawning enabled and junk is not lost upon death. All public events award Treasury Notes upon completion. Public events can become mutated.

Seasonal events are periodically available for a short period of time (e.g. two weeks), such as during the Fasnacht and Meat Week community events.

Uninvited guests, also known as party crashers, are a mechanic introduced to public events with *The Backwoods* update.

Public challenges, a cut type of event, were announced in an "Inside the Vault" article on Bethesda's website in March 2021. [1] While similar to seasonal events, public challenges were said to be of a global range to Appalachia, encouraging players to rely on each other to succeed. There has been no mention of public challenges since a 2021 Reddit AMA, [2] and the terminology appears to have been shelved. Invaders from Beyond was first announced as being a public challenge, but it was eventually released as a regular seasonal event, similar to ones before it.
